protein pockets may be mapped to the basis of theoretical target surfaces and that the resulting maps may be used to categorize protein pockets by their molecular diversity properties.

protein pockets can be categorized by their properties of molecular shape and functionality and that this categorization can be done by mapping protein pockets to a basis set theoretical target surfaces.

developing new methods for measuring molecular diversity, and in this paper we apply our method, QSCD, to biological proteins.
